obernants.section: Renaming preserves positional masks and reachable states
obernants.operator: Injective renaming on used byte values preserves every selected mask and reachable u64 state prefix; rejected inputs preserve errors only.
obernants.domain: Finite byte pairs plus injective renaming on their combined occurring support.
obernants.observation_scope: Full reachable state trajectory for accepted calls, result error for rejected calls.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact conditional source-derived induction; existing tests observe only outputs and state endpoint implications.

obernants.section: Accepted extremal fibers and partial histogram exclusion
obernants.operator: At accepted fixed lengths reconstruct zero and maximal score fibers; every successful fiber is empty outside the cap; histogram exclusion remains partial.
obernants.domain: Byte pairs at fixed n,m, with acceptance restriction explicit.
obernants.observation_scope: Returned Ok score and compatible antecedent pairs.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact symbolic extremal target and inner-bound histogram consequence; finite witnesses, no complete executable reconstructor.
obernants.assumptions: Finite valid byte slices and ordinary completed calls; no UTF-8 validity premise.

obernants.section: Byte observation and cross-API bridge domain
obernants.operator: Relate byte results to generic/English scalar results only on identical u8 inputs with min length <=64; distinguish UTF-8 bytes from tokens and Unicode scalars.
obernants.domain: Identical finite byte slices with shorter side <=64 for correspondence; arbitrary byte lengths for domain counterexamples.
obernants.observation_scope: Returned byte LCS and error variant; excludes scalar/grapheme normalization, traces and unrestricted API replacement.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional exact symbolic relation with finite native/integration witnesses; encoding/cap counterexamples constrain scope.
obernants.assumptions: Finite valid byte slices and ordinary completed calls; no UTF-8 validity premise.
